systems.country_label: National Identification Register; national ID system
systems.tiers: by the respondents' evidence each of the 112 districts has a national ID registration centre, newer districts being served from their mother districts, besides mass enrolment

note: The passages of the June 2025 ruling concern enrolment on the identity register; birth registration appears only in the applicants' submission as a source of delay, with nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
